cohort: 38 infertile women who conceived during the COVID-19 pandemic (34 after ART, 4 spontaneously)
finding: No associations were found between COVID-19 infection during pregnancy and maternal or neonatal morbidity, but a significant difference in delivery route was observed between women with and without COVID-19 symptoms.
mod_finding: A significant difference in delivery route was observed between women with and without COVID-19 symptoms.
